killedBy: issue #893: one opponent drives movement AND fire, not two MOVES toward that same opponent, which is the half that used to disagree
why: Restores the exact defect issue #893 fixed. With `engaged` back on nearest-by-distance, movement and the mine gate reason about the closest opponent while aim and fire still require line of sight, so whenever the nearest tank stands behind a wall the bot drives at one opponent and shoots at another on the same tick. It is silent: the bot still moves, still fires, still kills things, and no existing assertion separates the two derivations. Measured across disjoint seed sets, the split costs ~8-16% more tank deaths, reproducing in direction on both.
